This plot is small, only 0.08 hectares, and I have more than six hectares altogether to look after, so I will manage it with what I already have at home. I will spread manure from my cattle because it costs nothing, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer or improved seed for this piece—the shop is far and money is short. My family and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, and we will rely on the rains since there is no water source nearby for irrigation.
